newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end weak with lower futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end weak with lower futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Friday, traders said.

Gas oil slid $2.50 across the board on easier IPE futures, which saw front month July end at $162 a tonne. Spreads were stable, with a low sulphur diesel cargo changing hands at August IPE +$3.75 cif Le Havre for second half July.
Gasoline slipped $1 a tonne to $187.50 on fob barges as crude's recent fall's started to impact.
High sulphur barges ended the week steady at $85.25/$85.50 with sellers said to be holding back, after trading $1.50 to $2 lower earlier in the day.

High sulphur cargoes were talked a little lower at two means flat with bids $1.50 to $2 lower with Russian avails seen around. One percent was also weaker on the back of lower swaps and physical demand.
